playstyle: Poking, lockdown and defence. Chip the opponent down with safe pokes and layered strings, frustrate them with her parry (Inner Peace, f+1+2) and counter-hit tools, and move between Izumo (IZU), Genjitsu (GEN) and Miare (MIA). Some of her Kazama powers cost her own health, which is cheaper in Heat (Wavu). She has no i15 standing launcher.

stances.name: Izumo
stances.entry: f+3,2, 1,2,2 and MIA.1+2 transition to it
stances.note: IZU.3 is a Heat Engager; IZU.1,1 tornadoes and is used in her BnB.

stances.name: Genjitsu
stances.note: GEN.4 is a homing high, +4 to +6 on block; GEN.2 ends her tornado combo.

stances.name: Miare
stances.note: Follow-ups after a successful Inner Peace; MIA.1+2 goes into IZU.
